messages:
sara_sales: Vendor risk from BetaCorp asked for IAM evidence from our SIG/CAIQ answers. They want: SAML SP metadata (EntityID, ACS), confirmation MFA is required for UI logins, RBAC export showing group->role config, service account rotation policy, and a redacted audit sample. Who can assemble and ETA?

emily_security: We can assemble a bundle. Notes: MFA for SSO is enforced by customer IdP; we validate SAML assertions and check session ACR/age. For Hosted customers we enforce assertion validation; for Dedicated/Private some controls are customer-side. We'll provide: SAML metadata XML, RBAC CSV, redacted audit CSV, service-account guidance (TTL/rotation), and an attestation doc (legal sign). ETA 48h for draft.

marco_engineering: Tech details: we support SAML 2.0 POST binding, NameID formats, and SCIM 2.0 for group sync. Sample RBAC mapping snippet (redacted):
```yaml
- group: beta-engineers
  role: deployer
- group: beta-admins
  role: admin
```
Service accounts: issue OIDC tokens default 1h TTL; recommend rotation via CI. API keys supported but flagged as long-lived; recommend rotate every 90d. I can produce metadata + sample audit row.

oliver_cs: I'll collect their Okta/IdP metadata and confirm POC window. They also want to know if renaming groups breaks mappings.

emily_security: If mapping uses group name attribute, renames will break. Recommend SCIM or immutable IDs. We'll document both and include migration notes.

tina_legal: Send attestation draft to legal@redwood.example.com. Legal turnaround ~48-72h.

deploy-bot: Upload dir created at /confluence/security/iam-evidence. Artifacts pending.

sara_sales: Thanks team 44d. I'll confirm metadata and schedule a 30-min SAML test next Wed 9am PT.
